steps.title: Start with the finding
steps.body: The pipeline reports two instrument type mismatches. This is candidate evidence from a verified run, not a product verdict.

steps.title: Follow exact evidence
steps.body: F1 derives-from R1. The upstream graph says builds_on, while the inspector preserves the exact source relation.

steps.title: Reach the declared contract
steps.body: D1 declares both O13 instruments as Gauges and completes the exact F1 to R1 to D1 grounding closure.

steps.title: Preserve the contradiction
steps.body: D2 records Histogram registrations. It contradicts D1, stays visible, and never composes into the grounding closure.

steps.title: Keep policy indeterminate
steps.body: The specializes candidate remains lossy and policy-indeterminate with POLICY_OWNER_UNBOUND. The workbench cannot accept it.

steps.title: Inspect trust
steps.body: The receipt binds the source run, adapter artifacts, deterministic bytes, immutable upstream pin, and authority_effect none.
